## Why This Is Asked
This question probes practical cross-platform native module design for high-rate sensor data, including thread model, time synchronization, and resilience to hot-plug/power events—areas often neglected in RN apps.

## Key Concepts
- TurboModule/JSI bridging
- Dedicated native I/O thread and ring buffer
- Clock synchronization and drift correction
- Backpressure and frame dropping strategy
- USB hot-plug and power-event handling

## Code Example
```javascript
import {NativeModules} from 'react-native';
const {SensorBridge} = NativeModules;
SensorBridge.startStream({device: 'usb', rateHz: 10000});
SensorBridge.onFrame((frame)=>{ console.log(frame.ts, frame.data.length); });
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test clock-sync accuracy across devices?
- How to handle missing frames due to hot-plug events?

## Why This Is Asked

- On-device ML: GPU acceleration (Metal on iOS, Vulkan/NNAPI on Android)

- Lifecycle: clean shutdown, model swap without leaks, pause/resume semantics


- How would you secure data privacy if the model occasionally uses cloud fallback?
